items.label: LUMBAR SUPPORT PILLOW FOR CAR OR YOUR OFFICE
items.value: Made with high-density memory foam, this desk chair cushion balances firm posture support with long-lasting comfort - not overly hard, not too soft. Engineered to gently support the natural curve of your spine over time - unlike oversized pillows that collapse. Ideal for home offices, gaming sessions, or long commutes, it’s a supportive cushion for anyone who spends long hours sitting in cars, office chairs, couch, or recliner

items.label: PROMOTES BETTER POSTURE AND BACK SUPPORT
items.value: Our lumbar support pillow is designed to encourage better posture and provide reliable support while sitting. The contoured shape follows the spine’s curve to reduce slouching and fatigue during long hours at the desk, on a car ride, or while gaming. A versatile back support for office chair setups, couches, and recliners, this cushion is also an excellent lumbar support pillow for car rides and commuting comfort

items.label: DURABLE AND EASY TO MAINTAIN
items.value: The dense memory foam core provides consistent back support for office chair or car use without collapsing. Lightweight and portable, it moves easily between work chairs, couches, or vehicles. Unlike oversized cushions, it offers lower back and neck support without unnecessary bulk. A long-lasting addition to home or office furniture, this cushion makes a thoughtful gift for students, drivers, or anyone who values coccyx comfort while sitting

items.label: UNIVERSAL FIT WITH ADJUSTABLE STRAPS
items.value: Featuring dual adjustable straps with extension pieces, this ergonomic compact lumbar pillow for sciatica secures firmly to chairs up to 32 inches wide. It fits office chairs, gaming chairs, recliners, couches, and car seats, preventing slipping or constant readjusting. Built for both home and travel, it makes an excellent accessory for drivers, students in college, or office workers, add to your work from home pregnancy essentials with our backrest cushions

items.label: BREATHABLE & EASY TO CLEAN MESH COVER
items.value: Designed with airflow in mind, the breathable mesh cover helps keep you cool while working, driving, or relaxing. The cover is removable and machine washable, ensuring freshness after daily use. Easy to clean and maintain, this lumbar support cushion adds comfort without overheating, making it a great desk chair cushion or car back pillow. These car accessories are built for convenience, practical must haves / gifts for everyday travel use for men and women

items.label: Manufacturer Warranty Description
items.value: Lifetime Replacement Guarantee. If you have any issues at all with your back cushion, then contact us and we will issue a free replacement, for life.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Remove cover from memory foam. Cover is machine washable on a gentle cycle with cold water. Dryer safe (low heat) or air-dry setting. DO NOT PUT MEMORY FOAM IN WASHER OR DRYER.
